description: Atomically reserve candidates on a seen list before you work on them, so two runs on the same brief cannot deliver the same person. Logins another run holds, or that are already recorded as seen, come back as unavailable - deliver only the claimed ones. Claims expire, so an interrupted run releases its candidates instead of losing them and the next search returns them again. Creates the list on first use, under your plan list cap. Costs 0 credits.

list.description: List name. Created on first claim if it does not exist yet.

logins.description: GitHub logins to claim, max 100 per call.

ttlSeconds.description: Claim lifetime in seconds (60-3600, default 900). Out-of-range values are clamped.

name: claim_seen_logins
title: Claim logins for this run
